$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and autocomplete.

ignoreContextFiles.description: Disable AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md discovery for Desktop sessions. A project .pi/pix-desktop.jsonc value overrides the user default.

modelRef.description: Provider/model identifier used for new Desktop sessions.

fallbackModels.description: Ordered default-model fallbacks tried after modelRef.

defaultModel.description: Default model selection for new Desktop sessions.

enabled.description: Enable Auto for new Desktop drafts and route the first real prompt before session creation.

default.description: Start new Desktop conversation drafts in Auto routing mode by default.

modelRef.description: Primary router model. OpenRouter Jev Latest is available as openrouter/~typesafe/jev-latest.

defaultTier.description: Tier id used if every router model fails or returns an invalid choice.

id.description: Stable semantic tier id used by the router, e.g. simple, standard, complex, or expert.

description.description: Semantic description sent to the router when choosing this tier.

modelRef.description: Provider/model selected when the router chooses this tier.

tiers.description: Semantic target tiers the router may select.

modelRouting.description: Optional first-prompt automatic model routing. Disabled by default.

items.description: Provider/model identifier shown in the Desktop model picker.

visibleModels.description: Desktop-only user model-picker whitelist. Omit to show every available model.

thinkingByModel.description: Desktop-only last-applied thinking level per provider/model.

fallbackModels.description: Ordered prompt-enhancer fallbacks tried after modelRef.

modelRef.description: Model for inline autocomplete. Empty string disables LLM autocomplete.

fallbackModels.description: Ordered autocomplete fallbacks tried after modelRef.

debounceMs.description: Delay after typing before requesting completion.

timeoutMs.description: Hard timeout for a completion request.

includeRecentMessages.description: Recent conversation messages included as autocomplete context.

modelRef.description: Model used to generate compact session titles.

apiKey.description: Deepgram API key for Desktop voice input. Stored only in ~/.config/pi/pix-desktop.jsonc; project config cannot override this secret. Desktop exchanges it through /v1/auth/grant, which requires Member or higher Deepgram permission.

language.description: Deepgram language code sent directly to speech recognition, e.g. 'en', 'ru', 'uk', or 'de'.

dictation.description: Desktop voice dictation configuration. DEEPGRAM_API_KEY remains an environment fallback.

externalEditor.description: External editor used by the Project explorer. Aliases include zed, code/vscode, cursor, subl/sublime, idea/intellij, and webstorm; an executable path/name is also accepted.

reviewModelRef.description: Model used for Source Control LLM diff review, optionally with a :thinking suffix.

reviewFallbackModels.description: Ordered fallback models for Git diff review.

commitMessageModelRef.description: Model used to generate Git commit messages, optionally with a :thinking suffix.

commitMessageFallbackModels.description: Ordered fallback models for Git commit-message generation.

title: Pix Desktop Configuration
description: Configuration used only by Pix Desktop (~/.config/pi/pix-desktop.jsonc, with project overrides in <cwd>/.pi/pix-desktop.jsonc). TUI pix.jsonc is not inherited.
